description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_TestInstall class, which contains a static method to perform diagnostic checks on a Smarty installation, validating directories like template, compile, plugin, cache, config, and verifying the presence of expected system and plugin files.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_TestInstall
classes.description: A class providing a static method to diagnose a Smarty installation by verifying directories and the presence of essential plugin files.

methods.name: testInstall
methods.description: Performs comprehensive diagnostic checks of the Smarty installation directories and core plugins, reporting any missing or inaccessible components.
